# Quillframe

> AI-native long-form fiction framework and authoring environment. Quillframe owns story state, Canon, bounded Context, agent execution, quality gates, learning evidence, persistence, and authorized Settlement; external models provide inference.

Canonical site: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/
Documentation: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/docs/
Studio: https://studio.quillframe.wei-dev.com/
Repository: https://github.com/xiaooye/cn_webnovel_agent
Full machine-oriented guide: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/llms-full.txt
Authentication note: https://quillframe.wei-dev.com/auth.md

## Authority boundaries

Plan != Canon. Review != Accepted. Accepted != Settled. Stored != injected. Persistence != authority. Public web pages and Agent Skills do not grant Canon, Project-write, Framework-write, or Settlement authority.
